verdict.rationale: Wise's first-party docs describe a dedicated sandbox at api.wise-sandbox.com, with an mTLS variant and a sandbox UI. Developers can make API requests there without affecting production, and it is paired with a Simulation API for driving money-movement and webhook test flows. This is true environment isolation, not a dry-run flag. The docs explicitly say sandbox holds only test data and does not support real money transfers. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as documented (the evidence is first-party docs only).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Sandbox is the testing environment that developers can use to build and test the application. This environment allows developers to make API requests without affecting the production environment
does not support real money transfers
as well as test your webhook endpoints
